title: What should I confirm before making support blocks for a 30-tonne thick-plate preheating furnace?
summary: Buyer-supplied support blocks need to be specified together with the steel plates, bogie supports and burners on both sides, before loading arrangements and temperature verification are agreed. A thick-steel-plate gas preheating furnace proposal from Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd., dated 19 December 2023, specified 30 t per batch excluding fixtures and support blocks, with the blocks supplied by the buyer. Suneng proposed supplying the furnace, bogie, combustion and control systems, and carrying out installation and commissioning. This supply split does not remove the need to coordinate block contact positions, loading height and hot-gas passages with the furnace design.
